name: What are the space and amenity requirements for a Junior ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the space and amenity requirements for a Junior ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Junior ADU must be located within the existing walls of a proposed or existing single-family dwelling and can be no larger than 500 square feet. It requires an efficiency kitchen, which must include a cooking appliance, a food preparation counter, and storage cabinets. A JADU must also have a separate exterior entrance from the main home. While it's common for a JADU to have its own bedroom and living area, it is permitted to share a bathroom with the primary residence, distinguishing it from a full ADU's self-sufficiency requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: A JADU must be within an existing home, under 500 sq ft, have an efficiency kitchen, a separate entrance, and can share a bathroom with the main house.
